root_cause: Each harness attempt hid up to two extra OpenAI-SDK retries (worst case ~3 x 600 s plus backoff) that were neither counted by the harness retry loop nor written to the usage ledger. One slow/long HY3 call on a ~100k-token context therefore produced no observable event for longer than the 1500 s pool-stall window, and the pool-level detector (task completion only) aborted the whole arm. Whether the upstream call was a runaway generation or a transport hang cannot be determined from the retained artifacts.

fix.runtime_safety._install_llm_transport: force litellm max_retries=0 so the harness's own 6-attempt loop is the only retry authority and every attempt is ledgered (also re-bound for tau2's `from litellm import completion`; tau2's own num_retries=3 protocol unchanged)
fix.runtime_safety.completed_without_stall(p: a window with no task completion is not a stall if the usage ledger (append-only *.jsonl) grew; no completion AND no ledgered attempt in 1500 s is still fatal
fix.relay audit log: logs/relay_audit.jsonl: prompt-free, secret-free start/latency/status/usage/finish_reason per request

protocol_deviation: Transport-level retry policy differs from an unpatched upstream harness: SDK-internal retries disabled; harness-level retries (max 6, recorded) unchanged. No change to prompts, models, max_tokens, temperature, task set, or memory.
consequence_for_results: The 1258 ACE arm stays failed and is not resumed or merged. ACE, baseline and ExpeL must be re-run as five complete runs in a fresh namespace from one frozen source; no test-outcome-based selection.
